name: WebTopBarRoot
description: The web top bar: the frame's row above the rail from 768px on the web, and a desktop app's title bar at every width. Holds `WebTopBarStart`, `WebTopBarCenter` and `WebTopBarEnd`, in that order. It renders at every width; the web app renders it only from 768px.

props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: WebTopBarStart
description: The start of the bar, lined up with the rail's items: the workspace button and the workspace strip.

name: WebTopBarCenter
description: The center of the bar, centered on the window: the search field.

name: WebTopBarEnd
